""" def create_html_output(input_content: str) -> str: """ Produce an HTML string by safely injecting user-provided content into a template. """ # Escape special characters to neutralize any malicious markup. safe_content = html.escape(input_content, quote=True) # Use a format string that guarantees the placeholder exists. try: final_html = html_template.format(user_content=safe_content) except KeyError as exc: # If the placeholder is missing, raise a clear error. raise ValueError("The HTML template does not contain the required placeholder " "'{user_content}'.") from exc return final_html
